questions.unit: Human Health and Disease: Introduction about health; Common diseases in humans
questions.stem:
Consider the following statements about the human immune system.
A. Bone marrow and thymus are primary lymphoid organs.
B. Spleen, lymph nodes and tonsils are secondary lymphoid organs.
C. Lymphocytes mature in the secondary lymphoid organs before they migrate to the primary ones.
D. MALT constitutes about 50 per cent of the lymphoid tissue of the body.
Which statements are correct?

options.label: B
options.text: Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).

questions.unit: Human Health and Disease: Introduction about health; Common diseases in humans
questions.stem:
Consider the following statements about allergy and autoimmunity.
A. Allergy is an exaggerated response of the immune system to certain antigens called allergens.
B. During an allergic reaction, histamine and serotonin are released from mast cells.
C. Rheumatoid arthritis is an autoimmune disease.
D. Allergy is caused by bacterial pathogens that invade the blood.
Which statements are correct?

questions.unit: Microbes in Human Welfare: Microbes in household products; Microbes in industrial
questions.stem:
Consider the following statements about sewage treatment.
A. Primary treatment removes floating debris by sequential filtration and grit by sedimentation.
B. A small part of the activated sludge is pumped back into the aeration tank as inoculum.
C. The major part of the activated sludge is discarded without further digestion.
D. Anaerobic digestion of sludge forms a mixture of methane, hydrogen sulphide and carbon dioxide.
Which statements are correct?

questions.unit: Microbes in Human Welfare: Microbes in household products; Microbes in industrial
questions.stem:
Consider the following statements about biofertilisers.
A. Biofertilisers are organisms that enrich the nutrient quality of the soil.
B. The main sources of biofertilisers are bacteria, fungi and cyanobacteria.
C. Cyanobacteria also add organic matter to the soil and increase its fertility.
D. Rhizobium fixes nitrogen in association with the roots of cereals such as wheat.
Which statements are correct?

Which statements are correct?

options.label: B
options.text: Aerobic microbes of the flocs oxidised the organic matter in the aerated effluent

options.label: C
options.text: Sedimentation removed all dissolved gases from the effluent

options.label: D
options.text: Primary sludge was recycled into the effluent as inoculum
